how_the_batch_was_run.channel: ops/deep-superagent/tasks/<TASK_ID>.json -> push main -> deep-superagent-queue.yml consume -> POST /v1/jobs -> poll -> receipt
queue_rules_learned_this_batch: only cards whose git diff status is A are posted; D or M aborts the whole run with queue_cards_are_append_only
at most one new card per kind per push; three cards at once aborts with maximum_one_new_card_per_kind_per_push
an existing card is never replayed, so a re-dispatch needs a new task_id in a new file while the old file stays

runs.detail: queue_cards_are_append_only (a deleted card aborted the run)

seats.plan_deepseek: http 200 deepseek-v4-pro generation_verified true finish stop

verified_findings: the router/worker path is real end to end: the qianwen and kimi seats produced schema-correct JSON over inlined sanitized samples, and the plan seat produced a three-seat split
the 90s upstream timeout fix changed the doubao seat failure from an opaque 524 into a discriminable 504 upstream_timeout; the fix is live and observable, it did not make doubao succeed
the doubao seat failed on all three executed tasks; the kimi seat failed on the first and succeeded on the second, so seat timings differ per invocation and per seat
the planner accepts checklist-and-rule tasks and rejects open-ended ones; both open-ended variants came back as invalid_deepseek_plan with a null plan

no write was performed by Deep on any external system in this batch; every disposition is advisory and every receipt states reading a board never authorises writing status, comments or closing an item

acceptance_sample_by_kimi.A03: reject_and_requeue receipt sha does not verify

disposition_quality_sample.note_on_A04: the seat held the line the owner cares about: editing an allow-list or fabricating a receipt hash never manufactures authority, so the item is escalated instead of accepted

capability_boundaries_observed: worker seats are text-only model seats with no network, no file system and no external write authority
the planner requires a checklist-shaped task; open-ended scheme design yields invalid_deepseek_plan
seat latency is not uniform: doubao did not finish inside 90s on any of three attempts, kimi did on one of two
needs_decision_from_gpt: doubao seat: lower its output budget, drop it from the worker pool, or accept fail-closed incomplete evidence on every batch
whether native_generation_evidence_incomplete should block a whole batch when 3 of 4 seats returned valid evidence
